captions: An image of a fringe pattern produced by quantum scattering of molecules in an experiment at the Vienna Centre of Quantum Science and Technology, University of Vienna, as reported in Nature Nanotechnology, March 2012.
The experiment shows that a beam of molecules shot through a fine grating produces a distinctive fringe pattern consistent with the predictions of quantum theory.
A feature of this experiment is that it shows how such patterns form one particle at a time.
